caption: The drawing features two views of a decorative cup in grayscale pencil on a light, off-white background. The upper section displays a circular top view of the cup, divided into six sections by radiating lines, with each section containing intricate botanical motifs of leaves and flowers. Two handles extend horizontally from opposite sides of the circle, each with a rope-like pattern. The center of the top view has the markings "I R * M" and an additional small symbol below these letters. The bottom section shows a side view of the same cup, emphasizing the three-dimensional form, ornate surface relief with botanical motifs that match the top view, and the rope-patterned handles curving outward. The design and shading are detailed, and the artist's signature and date, "Laurence Hynes," are present in the bottom right corner.
title: Silver Bowl
